meta_description: Solent Decorating Services in Southampton offers interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating. Free quotes, friendly service. Call today.
hero_subhead: Interior or exterior work in Southampton? We handle everything from a single bedroom to a full house refurbishment—cleanly, on time, no mess.
services_subhead: From interior redecorating to full exterior work, we handle every aspect of painting and wallpapering with attention to detail and care for your home.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Living rooms, kitchens, bedrooms, and hallways transformed with premium finishes. We prepare surfaces properly, protect your furniture, and leave zero mess behind.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Fascia, soffits, doors, and window frames painted to last. Weather-resistant finishes protect against Southampton's coastal weather and salt air.

services.title: Wallpapering & Hanging
services.desc: Precise hanging of feature walls or complete rooms. We source, measure, and fit—or work with your chosen paper. Straight edges, no bubbles, professional finish.

services.title: Woodwork Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, and panelling sanded and refinished. Hand-painted or stained to your colour choice, with durable protective coats.

services.title: Damp & Problem Areas
services.desc: Preparation of damp patches or water-damaged surfaces before redecoration. We assess the cause and prepare walls properly so paint lasts.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Office refreshes and shop fronts handled outside business hours. Reliable, professional, and tailored to minimise disruption to your operations.

about_pullquote: I started this to prove decorators can be honest, clean, and actually finish on time.
about_para_1: Solent Decorating Services was founded 12 years ago in Southampton with a simple mission: to bring reliable, quality decorating back to the area. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local team, completing over 500 residential and commercial projects across Southampton and the surrounding villages. We've built our reputation on showing up when we say we will, leaving your home spotless, and treating every wall like it's our own.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen to what they want, prepare surfaces properly (no shortcuts), and charge fair prices without surprise add-ons. We don't cut corners on prep work—that's where quality decorating begins. Whether you're refreshing a bedroom or transforming a period property, we take pride in work that lasts and looks right from day one.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the entire lounge redecorated—walls, woodwork, ceiling. Turned up on time, worked steadily, and left the place immaculate. No faffing about. Fair price too. Already booked them for the hallway.
reviews.author: Martin T.

reviews.text: My daughter's bedroom needed doing after water damage. They sorted the prep, matched the colour perfectly, and it looks brand new. Couldn't fault it. Very professional team.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Front door and exterior woodwork painted. Brilliant job. They were clean, efficient, and finished exactly when they said. Will definitely recommend to neighbours.
reviews.author: David K.
